summary: Diginex Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a Sale and Purchase Agreement on April 16, 2026, to acquire all issued shares of Resulticks Global Companies Pte. Limited and its subsidiaries. The aggregate consideration is US$1.5 billion, payable entirely in equity via 1,133,333,333 newly issued ordinary shares at an implied price of US$1.32 per share (based on DGNX stock price). Closing is subject to customary conditions, including shareholder approval, Nasdaq listing, regulatory consents, and governance changes. Post-closing, up to US$200 million in capital injections will fund Resulticks through March 2027. What to watch: shareholder vote, lock-up restrictions, and Nasdaq listing approval.
